nodes.name: Wage labour in coin
nodes.desc: Wage labour in coin: the civic knowledge of this form of organization. Reclassified from registry institution inst.coined_wage (architecture §5.7); the institution itself is established by its owning system once this civic is complete.

nodes.name: Joint-stock company
nodes.desc: Joint-stock company: the civic knowledge of this form of organization. Reclassified from registry institution inst.joint_stock (architecture §5.7); the institution itself is established by its owning system once this civic is complete.

nodes.name: Craft guilds
nodes.emerged: ~100 BCE Roman craft collegia; ~1100 CE European craft guilds
nodes.desc: Chartered associations of master craftsmen control admission to and training in their trade. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: chartered associations of master craftsmen controlling admission and training

nodes.name: Religious toleration
nodes.emerged: ~260 BCE edicts of Ashoka; 313 CE Edict of Milan; 1598 CE Edict of Nantes
nodes.desc: The law tolerates more than one faith. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: legal toleration of more than one faith

nodes.name: Merchant law
nodes.emerged: ~800 CE Islamic commercial law; ~1100 CE European law merchant and fair courts
nodes.desc: Merchant courts enforce contracts between strangers. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: merchant courts enforcing contracts between strangers

nodes.name: Central banking
nodes.emerged: 1668 CE Sveriges Riksbank; 1694 CE Bank of England
nodes.desc: A public bank holds the state's accounts and issues notes. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: a public bank holding state accounts and issuing notes

nodes.name: Compulsory education
nodes.emerged: 1717 CE Prussian school decree; 1763 CE Prussian General School Regulation; 1852 CE Massachusetts compulsory attendance law
nodes.desc: The law requires children to attend school. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: a legal duty of school attendance for children

nodes.name: Boards of health
nodes.emerged: 1377 CE Ragusa quarantine ordinance; 1486 CE permanent health magistracy of Venice; 1848 CE English General Board of Health
nodes.desc: A public authority holds powers of quarantine and sanitation. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: a public health authority with powers of quarantine and sanitation

nodes.name: Abolition of slavery and serfdom
nodes.emerged: ~594 BCE Solon's cancellation of debt bondage at Athens; 1833 CE British Slavery Abolition Act; 1861 CE emancipation of the Russian serfs
nodes.desc: Slavery and hereditary bondage are abolished by law. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: the legal abolition of slavery and hereditary bondage

nodes.name: Central economic planning
nodes.emerged: 1921 CE Gosplan; 1928 CE first Soviet Five-Year Plan
nodes.desc: The state plans output and allocation for the whole economy. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: state planning of output and allocation for the whole economy

nodes.name: Gift exchange networks
nodes.emerged: ~40 kya shell-bead exchange; ~10 kya obsidian networks
nodes.desc: Bands exchange gifts and partners over long distances, moving rare materials hand to hand.
capabilities: bands exchange gifts and partners over long distances, moving rare materials hand to hand

nodes.name: Debt remission edicts
nodes.emerged: ~2,400 BCE Urukagina's reforms; ~1,750 BCE Old Babylonian misharum edicts
nodes.desc: The king cancels debts and frees debt-bondsmen at his accession or in crisis.
capabilities: the king cancels debts and frees debt-bondsmen at his accession or in crisis

nodes.name: Planned towns
nodes.emerged: ~2,600 BCE Mohenjo-daro grid
nodes.desc: Streets, drains and plots are laid out to a plan before building.
capabilities: streets, drains and plots are laid out to a plan before building

nodes.name: Water rights
nodes.emerged: ~1,754 BCE Hammurabi's canal-maintenance laws
nodes.desc: Law fixes who may draw canal water and who must maintain the banks.
capabilities: law fixes who may draw canal water and who must maintain the banks

nodes.name: Building regulation
nodes.emerged: ~10 BCE Augustan height limit; ~64 CE Neronian rebuilding rules
nodes.desc: Law sets heights, materials and fire breaks for urban building.
capabilities: law sets heights, materials and fire breaks for urban building

nodes.name: Public granaries
nodes.emerged: ~123 BCE Roman grain law; ~54 BCE Han ever-normal granaries
nodes.desc: The state stores grain in good years and sells or issues it in dearth.
capabilities: the state stores grain in good years and sells or issues it in dearth

nodes.name: Forest law
nodes.emerged: ~1,079 CE New Forest; ~1,217 CE Charter of the Forest
nodes.desc: Woods and game are reserved by law and their use licensed.
capabilities: woods and game are reserved by law and their use licensed

nodes.name: Legal estates
nodes.emerged: ~1,000 CE three orders; ~1,302 CE Estates General
nodes.desc: Society is divided by law into orders — clergy, nobles, commoners — each with its own rights.
capabilities: society is divided by law into orders — clergy, nobles, commoners — each with its own rights

nodes.name: Manorialism
nodes.emerged: ~800 CE Carolingian polyptychs
nodes.desc: Peasants hold land from a lord in return for labour services and dues and may not leave.
capabilities: peasants hold land from a lord in return for labour services and dues and may not leave

nodes.name: Market fairs
nodes.emerged: ~1,150 CE Champagne fairs
nodes.desc: Chartered periodic fairs bring distant merchants together under a special peace and court.
capabilities: chartered periodic fairs bring distant merchants together under a special peace and court

nodes.name: Mercantilism
nodes.emerged: ~1,621 CE Thomas Mun; ~1,664 CE Colbert's tariff
nodes.desc: The state promotes exports, protects manufactures and hoards bullion through trade rules.
capabilities: the state promotes exports, protects manufactures and hoards bullion through trade rules

nodes.name: Poor law
nodes.emerged: ~1,601 CE Elizabethan Poor Law
nodes.desc: Parishes levy a rate to relieve the destitute and set the able-bodied to work.
capabilities: parishes levy a rate to relieve the destitute and set the able-bodied to work

nodes.name: Stock exchange
nodes.emerged: ~1,531 CE Antwerp bourse; ~1,602 CE Amsterdam exchange
nodes.desc: Shares in companies are traded in a regulated market.
capabilities: shares in companies are traded in a regulated market

nodes.name: Antitrust law
nodes.emerged: ~1,890 CE Sherman Act
nodes.desc: Law forbids cartels and breaks up monopolies.
capabilities: law forbids cartels and breaks up monopolies

nodes.name: Cooperatives
nodes.emerged: ~1,844 CE Rochdale Pioneers
nodes.desc: Members jointly own a shop, farm or bank and share its surplus.
capabilities: members jointly own a shop, farm or bank and share its surplus

nodes.name: Customs union
nodes.emerged: ~1,834 CE Zollverein
nodes.desc: Several states abolish internal tariffs and share a common external tariff.
capabilities: several states abolish internal tariffs and share a common external tariff

nodes.name: Factory inspection
nodes.emerged: ~1,833 CE Factory Act
nodes.desc: Inspectors enforce limits on child labour and working hours.
capabilities: inspectors enforce limits on child labour and working hours

nodes.name: Free trade
nodes.emerged: ~1,846 CE repeal of the Corn Laws
nodes.desc: Tariffs are lowered and trade opened by treaty and statute.
capabilities: tariffs are lowered and trade opened by treaty and statute

nodes.name: Trade unions
nodes.emerged: ~1,824 CE repeal of the Combination Acts
nodes.desc: Workers combine to bargain collectively and to strike.
capabilities: workers combine to bargain collectively and to strike

nodes.name: Limited liability
nodes.emerged: ~1,855 CE Limited Liability Act
nodes.desc: Shareholders risk only their stake, not their whole fortune.
capabilities: shareholders risk only their stake, not their whole fortune

nodes.name: Nature conservation
nodes.emerged: ~1,872 CE Yellowstone National Park
nodes.desc: Land is set aside to protect landscapes, species and their habitats.
capabilities: land is set aside to protect landscapes, species and their habitats

nodes.name: Civil rights law
nodes.emerged: ~1,964 CE Civil Rights Act
nodes.desc: Law forbids discrimination by race, religion or sex in public life and work.
capabilities: law forbids discrimination by race, religion or sex in public life and work

nodes.name: Climate accords
nodes.emerged: ~1,992 CE UN Framework Convention on Climate Change
nodes.desc: States negotiate shared limits on greenhouse emissions.
capabilities: states negotiate shared limits on greenhouse emissions

nodes.name: Environmental regulation
nodes.emerged: ~1,970 CE US Environmental Protection Agency
nodes.desc: Agencies limit pollution of air, water and soil by permit and standard.
capabilities: agencies limit pollution of air, water and soil by permit and standard

nodes.name: Multilateral trade rules
nodes.emerged: ~1,947 CE General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade
nodes.desc: Many states bind their tariffs and settle trade disputes under shared rules.
capabilities: many states bind their tariffs and settle trade disputes under shared rules

nodes.name: Zoning
nodes.emerged: ~1,916 CE New York zoning resolution
nodes.desc: Cities divide land into zones with permitted uses and building envelopes.
capabilities: cities divide land into zones with permitted uses and building envelopes
